description: Commit 3: callable generateGame. Depends on FEAT-001 modules. Adds quota, model wrapper, mock model, handler, index.js, firebase.json emulators/functions block, and handler + callable e2e emulator tests. Independent of rules (FEAT-003) except that e2e uses the current firestore.rules; re-run e2e after FEAT-003.
steps: Replace firebase.json per design sec 8 (functions block with source functions, emulators auth 9099, functions 5001, firestore 8080, ui disabled, singleProjectMode). No predeploy hook.

Create functions/lib/quota.js: reserve(db, uid, now) single transaction reading users/{uid} (role/status gate: teacher/parent ok, student must be active, else permission-denied pending/profile), usage/{uid}_{yyyymmdd} and usage/global_{yyyymmdd}; limits, lockUntil busy, expireAt; finish(db, ..., {game|outcome}) one transaction creating games/{autoId} (fields per sec 4.1, expireAt +365d) and updating counters; refund cap 3/day, global never refunded.

Create functions/lib/model.js (GoogleGenAI vertexai, retryOptions attempts 1, explicit BLOCK_LOW_AND_ABOVE safetySettings for 4 categories on both calls, abortSignal, normalized {text, blocked, blockReason, finishReason, inTokens, outTokens}; confirm field names in node_modules/@google/genai/dist/genai.d.ts) and functions/lib/mock-model.js with the same interface, steered by trigger words mockinvalidonce, mockinvalidtwice, mockblocked, mockoffTopic.

Create functions/lib/handler.js handleGenerate(request, deps) exactly in the order of design sec 1.1 and error table 1.4: HttpsError mapping with details.code, fixed REFUSALS copy, retry-once logic, 80 s budget, structured logs without prompt/model text, model receives only sanitized prompt + gradeHint (classify) and validated fields (generate).

Create functions/index.js: onCall options from design sec 1 (region us-central1, timeoutSeconds 90, memory 512MiB, maxInstances 5, concurrency 8, cors emulator-true else Pages origin, serviceAccount mq-game-builder), lazy getModel(), MQ_VERTEX_LOCATION via defineString default 'us', mock only when process.env.FUNCTIONS_EMULATOR === 'true' && process.env.MQ_MOCK_MODEL === '1'; do not reference K_SERVICE.

Write functions/test/handler.test.js (Admin SDK Firestore emulator, scripted mock via deps) covering every case listed in design sec 9(b) including logger-captured no-prompt-leak and payload-captured no uid/email/name assertions, day rollover with injected now(), atomicity.

Write functions/test/e2e.test.js per design sec 9(d): Admin creates Auth users + users docs, Web SDK 13.2.0 custom-token sign-in, connectFunctionsEmulator, httpsCallable; cases unauth, pending student, happy path (creator can read game via rules, other user cannot), refusal, quota exhaustion, invalid-once retry, client write to games denied (after FEAT-003 rules this is truly enforced; before it, assert only what current rules do and note it in findings), mock inactive when MQ_MOCK_MODEL unset, and a static assertion on the index.js guard string and no K_SERVICE.
Commit: 'feat(functions): generateGame callable with mock-model tests'.
acceptance_criteria: handler.test.js passes under auth+firestore emulators with 0 failures

e2e.test.js passes under auth+firestore+functions emulators with MQ_MOCK_MODEL=1 with 0 failures (or, if the Functions emulator cannot start on Node 26 and `npx -p node@24` also fails, the blocker is recorded in findings and the e2e is reported NOT executed)
unit tests from FEAT-001 still pass; existing 53 rules tests still pass with the new firebase.json
No secrets, no real model call, no live-project command was run
verification: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-mathquest "node --test rules-test/rules.test.js" (53 pass)
findings: Commit 19be474. EXECUTED (real output): unit 262/262 pass; handler 27/27 pass; e2e 10/10 pass (MQ_MOCK_MODEL=1, Functions emulator ran on host Node 26, no npx node@24 needed); rules 53/53 pass with new firebase.json. NOT executed: client harness (FEAT later), any deploy. Notes for later steps: (1) functions/.env.demo-mathquest (MQ_VERTEX_LOCATION=us) is committed because the Functions emulator otherwise blocks on an interactive defineString prompt; any emulators:exec with functions needs it. (2) Run e2e via Start-Process with redirected output; a killed run leaves node.exe holding ports 4400/9099/5001 and the next run fails 'port taken' (kill the firebase.js node process). (3) e2e games read test is adaptive: current firestore.rules has no games match, so creator and other-user reads are both asserted denied; after FEAT-003 it asserts creator allowed/other denied (rulesHaveGames regex) - re-run e2e after FEAT-003. Client writes to games/usage are denied under current rules (default deny). (4) One incident: an early e2e variant with MQ_MOCK_MODEL unset made the real Vertex client run inside the emulator; it issued a request to oauth2.googleapis.com/token and got HTTP 403 (ApiError) twice with the test prompt 'tell me about volcanoes' in the classify request; no content returned, no credentials existed. That test was removed; the mock-inactive check is now STATIC only (index.js guard string, no K_SERVICE) - TRACED, not executed. Do not run the emulator without MQ_MOCK_MODEL=1. (5) handler returns remaining:null for pre-filter refusals (no quota read). Response game omits createdBy/creatorRole (and createdAt/expireAt). (6) quota.reserve returns ctx{uid,day,limit,role,grade,remaining}; users.grade is the default grade; teacher/parent need no status check. (7) mock-model: classify topic = cleaned prompt (<=60 chars), so trigger words in the prompt steer generate; mockblocked blocks classify only. (8) TRACED only: model.js real Vertex call path (field names checked against genai.d.ts: promptFeedback.blockReason, candidates[0].finishReason, usageMetadata.promptTokenCount/candidatesTokenCount; ThinkingLevel/HarmCategory enums), production cors/serviceAccount options, LOCK/budget timing (80s/25s) not exercised.
